frames.heading: Mexico
frames.body: As the sun sets over Mexico beach, the air fills with the sounds of music and laughter. A crowd gathers on the sandy shore, swaying to the rhythm of live music. Mojo steps up, his energy electric, ready to share his dream of cosmic funk. With a playful wink, he gears up to start a beachside dance party that will spread joy across the galaxy!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Hola, Mexico! I can feel the energy already - this place is alive!

frames.heading: Fan
frames.body: Mojo! We're so happy to see you!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: You all ready for a cosmic journey?

frames.heading: Fan
frames.body: Absolutely! But tell us - what's next for you? We heard you're planning something big!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: You bet! I've got this wild idea to take funk beyond Earth. I want to spread it across the galaxy!

frames.heading: Fan
frames.body: Across the galaxy? How do you plan to do that?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: With music, of course! I want to perform on the Moon, Mars, and who knows where else! Every planet needs some funky beats!

frames.heading: Fan
frames.body: That sounds amazing! We'd love to dance with Martians and robots!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Exactly! Just imagine the rhythm of the universe coming together. We'll groove like never before! But first, let's turn up the funk right here in Mexico City!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Alright, before we take this party to the next level, let's make sure we're in sync! We'll be using our hands to bring the groove to life.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: To start, we've gotta raise our hands to the camera - nice and steady, like we're ready to take the stage. Hold them still so the game can lock in on our movements. The magic happens when we match our hands with the symbols on the screen!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Once we've got our hands locked in, the real fun begins. We'll hit those symbols with precision, moving to the rhythm. It's all about feeling the groove, reacting to the beat, and keeping that energy flowing!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: When those symbols appear, we've got two moves to nail together - first, the open palm! We spread our fingers wide, like we're catching all that cosmic energy!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Then, there's the closed palm. We clench that fist, strong and ready, like we're smashing through the beat! Ready to rock this stage together? Let's light it up!
